description: Retrieve performance insights for a single campaign. Returns a list response (`data[]` with `first_id`/`last_id`/`has_more` for paging). Each row carries `id`, `start_time`, `end_time`, plus the projected `fields` such as impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc, cpm, readable_time, campaign_name, ad_group_name, and ad_name. Combine `aggregation_level`, `sort`, and `limit` to rank entities (e.g. the top ad by clicks). Monetary metrics (spend, cpc, cpm) are in the account's currency as decimal values, not micros.

after.description: Pagination cursor: pass `last_id` from a previous page to fetch the next page.

aggregation_level.description: Scope each row is aggregated to (e.g. 'ad' to break results out per ad even when querying a campaign). Combine with `sort` + `limit` to rank entities.

before.description: Pagination cursor: pass `first_id` from a previous page to fetch the previous page.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to report on.

fields.description: Fields to project in each row, e.g. ['ad_id','ad_name','campaign_name','readable_time','impressions','clicks','spend','ctr','cpc','cpm'].

filters.description: Advanced filter expressions, passed through to the API as-is.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-10000).

since.description: Start date of the reporting window (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Combined with `until` into a date_range time filter.

sort.description: Sort expressions applied in order, e.g. [{ "field": "clicks", "direction": "desc" }] to rank by most clicks.

direction.description: Sort direction; omit to use the API default.

field.description: Field or metric to sort by, e.g. 'clicks' or 'spend'.

time_granularity.description: Aggregation bucket size: 'daily' for one row per day, or 'none' for a single aggregated row over the whole window.

until.description: End date of the reporting window (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Combined with `since` into a date_range time filter.

name: get_campaign_insights
title: Get campaign insights
